opportunities.name: Cross-office meeting sync brief (time difference + holidays → email)
opportunities.description: For a pair of cities and a target month, get the time difference in the timeanddate.com Time Zone Converter, look up the second city's country holidays, then draft a 'Sync' email to ops with the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com, go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Type {city_a} in 'Search for city or time zone...' and pick the matching suggestion
Type {city_b} in the same search box and pick the matching suggestion
Read the hour difference between city_b and city_a
Go to Calendar > Holidays and observances, choose {country} (via the A–Z list or suggested countries)
Open the holiday list for that country/year and note the public holidays in {month}
Open mail compose and set To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Sync: {city_a} / {city_b}, {month}'
Set Body = '{city_b} is {offset} hours ahead from {city_a}. Avoid: {month} {holiday_days}.'
Send (in the recording the person clicked Discard)

instances.values: city_a=New York, city_b=Berlin, country=Germany, month=December, recipient=ops@example.com, offset=6, avoid Dec 25 & 26
city_a=London, city_b=Sydney, country=Australia, month=January, recipient=ops@example.com, offset=10, avoid Jan 1 & 26

opportunities.name: Company account brief (EDGAR 10-K lookup + Wikipedia → email)
opportunities.description: For a stock ticker, find the company in SEC EDGAR full-text search, filter to 10-K annual reports to get the latest filing date, get HQ, employee count and CEO from Wikipedia, then email an account brief.
steps: Open EDGAR full-text search
Clear the 'Company name, ticker, CIK number or individual's name' box and type {ticker}
Pick the matching company from the autocomplete and run the search
Open the 'Form' refine panel and click '10-K Annual report'
Note the most recent 10-K filed date
On Wikipedia, search for {company_name} and open the article
Note HQ city, number of employees and CEO from the infobox
Open mail compose, set To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Account brief: {company_name} ({ticker})'
Set Body = '{company_name}: HQ {hq}, {employees} employees, CEO {ceo}. Latest 10-K filed {date}.'
Send (in the recording the person clicked Discard)
parameters: hq / employees / ceo / latest 10-K date (looked up)
